code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap
det=pd.read_csv("bbs10/site_conservation_full.csv")
names=["CCT1","CCT2","CCT3","CCT4","CCT5","CCT6A","CCT7","CCT8","BBS6","BBS10","BBS12"]
order=sorted(det.mm_cpn.unique(), key=lambda s:int(s[1:]))
grp=det.drop_duplicates('mm_cpn').set_index('mm_cpn')['group'].to_dict()
M=np.zeros((len(names),len(order))); lab=np.empty((len(names),len(order)),dtype=object)
for i,p in enumerate(names):
    sub=det[det.protein==p].set_index('mm_cpn')
    for j,c in enumerate(order):
        if c not in sub.index: M[i,j]=0; lab[i,j]="-"; continue
        r=sub.loc[c]; M[i,j]= 2 if r.identical else (1 if r.chem_equiv else 0); lab[i,j]=r.residue[0]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(15,5.4))
ax.imshow(M,cmap=ListedColormap(["#f6dede","#fde9b8","#2f7d4f"]),vmin=0,vmax=2,aspect='auto')
for i in range(len(names)):
    for j in range(len(order)):
        ax.text(j,i,lab[i,j],ha='center',va='center',fontsize=8,color="white" if M[i,j]==2 else "#333")
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order)))
ax.set_xticklabels([f"{c}  {grp[c]}" for c in order],fontsize=7.5,rotation=90)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(names))); ax.set_yticklabels(names,fontsize=10)
for j,c in enumerate(order):
    if grp[c]=="catalytic/Mg": ax.axvspan(j-0.5,j+0.5,color="#c0392b",alpha=0.12)
ax.axhline(7.5,color='k',lw=1.6)
ax.set_title("Nucleotide-site conservation, group II chaperonin (Mm-cpn 3RUW, ADP-AlFx) mapped by structural alignment onto AlphaFold models.\n"
             "Green = identical to Mm-cpn, yellow = chemically equivalent, pink = lost or gapped. Red bands are the 6 Mg2+ / gamma-phosphate / catalytic positions.",fontsize=9.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

seqs=json.load(open("bbs10/seqs.json")); b=seqs["BBS10_HUMAN"][2]
print("BBS10 (Q8TAM1) local sequence at mapped site positions:")
for lbl,p in [("GDGTT-equivalent loop, D81",81),("NDG-equivalent, N50",50),("cat. Lys position, R181",181),
              ("cat. Asp position (GroEL D398), G416",416),("GGG loop, G603",603),("adenine-pocket Glu, E679",679)]:
    print(f"  {lbl:40s} {b[max(0,p-9):p-1]}[{b[p-1]}]{b[p:p+8]}")
